label: Test by realization and sample controls of per-effect direction
note: Tests the step to per-effect direction (conclusion of argument 9203e79c): if a giver's choice settled only a law, seeing to the law's adoption is compatible with seeing to neither the particular effect nor its contrary, and a law's support matching the outputs does not establish causal realization. Per-effect direction then needs the premises of 9203e79c to bear on each effect, not on a law. The STIT model has no plan or governing vocabulary, so it tests this only at the level of seeing-to. It neither supports nor refutes the statement.
